content: Why did auth-service fail at 2:31 AM?

content.root_cause: The auth-service failed due to high CPU utilization causing a threshold breach.
content.summary: The incident occurred at 2:31 AM, with evidence from logs and metrics indicating a surge in CPU usage, leading to service unavailability errors in the api-gateway logs [LOG] and metrics [METRICS]. The dashboard screenshot [IMAGE] and metrics file [METRICS] support the high CPU utilization finding.
recommendations: Investigate and optimize the code to reduce CPU utilization
Implement autoscaling to handle sudden spikes in traffic
Configure alerts for high CPU utilization to prevent similar incidents
